name: The Jimi Hendrix Experience

whyMatters.en: Feedback, space, and fire: Hendrix reinvents the electric guitar as an instrument of weather—every later guitar hero walks in that shadow.
whyMatters.zh: 反馈、空间与火焰：Hendrix 把电吉他重新发明成天气仪器——此后所有吉他英雄都在他的阴影里走。

note.zh: 迷幻失真成为主流事件
Blues 被扩音到神话尺度

lyricQuotes: Excuse me while I kiss the sky

shortBio.en: The permanent rewrite of what an electric guitar can do.
shortBio.zh: 电吉他可能性的上限被永久改写。

body.en:
With Mitch Mitchell and Noel Redding, Hendrix turns the guitar into feedback, space, and controlled fire. Blues gets stretched until it becomes myth and physics at once.

After that, every hero pose is a footnote.
body.zh:
与 Mitch Mitchell、Noel Redding 一起，Hendrix 把吉他变成反馈、空间与可控的火。Blues 被拉长，直到同时是神话与物理。

在那之后，所有英雄姿势都是脚注。

body.en:
Hendrix does not play louder versions of old licks. He treats amp noise, pan, and sustain as vocabulary—the instrument becomes an atmosphere machine.

Guitar-hero culture afterward is walking through a doorway he already burned open.
body.zh:
Hendrix 不是把老 lick 弹得更响。他把音箱噪声、声像与延音当词汇——乐器变成大气机器。

此后的吉他英雄文化，都是从他烧开的门洞里走过。

title.en: Purple Haze: psychedelic distortion as news
title.zh: Purple Haze：迷幻失真变成新闻

body.en:
1967. The riff leans, the lyric hallucinates, the solo refuses polite resolution. Purple Haze makes psychedelic distortion a mainstream event, not a basement hobby.

London hears America rewritten by a left-handed architect of voltage.
body.zh:
1967 年。riff 倾斜，歌词致幻，solo 拒绝礼貌收束。Purple Haze 让迷幻失真成为主流事件，不是地下室爱好。

伦敦听见一个左撇子电压建筑师重写的美国。

title.en: Voodoo Child: Blues scaled to myth

body.en:
Slight Return stretches a Blues cry across stadium-sized air. Wah and fire imagery are not decoration; they are the plot.

Hard Rock and Metal later chase this scale. The shadow is permanent.
body.zh:
Slight Return 把 Blues 的哭喊拉过体育馆尺度的空气。哇音与火焰意象不是装饰，是情节。

后来 Hard Rock 与 Metal 追这个尺度。阴影是永久的。

title.en: Everyone after plays in the afterimage
title.zh: 后来的人都在残影里弹

body.en:
From arena shredders to alternative noise poets, Hendrix sits upstream as permission: the guitar can paint, not only accompany.

Psychedelic, Hard Rock, and experimental edges all drink from the same scorched well.
body.zh:
从体育馆速弹手到另类噪声诗人，Hendrix 在上游给出许可：吉他可以绘画，不只是伴奏。

迷幻、Hard Rock、实验边缘都从同一口烧焦的井里喝水。

title.en: He talks soft; the amp does not

body.en:
Interview Hendrix is often shy, funny, almost gentle. Stage Hendrix is weather.

Keep both quotes. The gap between the soft voice and the burning instrument is the myth's human core.
body.zh:
访谈里的 Hendrix 常常腼腆、好笑、近乎温柔。舞台上的 Hendrix 是天气。

两种话都留着。轻声与燃烧乐器之间的缝，才是神话的人味核心。

note.en: Amp as instrument: feedback enters the melody.
note.zh: 音箱即乐器：feedback 进入旋律。
